content:
With the new legendary crafting system, we will have the opportunity to get, trade and craft individual effects as mods in Fallout 76 from September 3rd, 2024. Here you will find a list of all mod effects with names, descriptions, manufacturing ingredients and possible uses. If you don't know how the new Legendary Crafting system works, check out this article: [PTS] Legendary Crafting with Effects of Your Choice (Patch 54 / Milepost Zero)

 Adrenal 

 [Weapon] +10% damage per kill during a killstreak.

[Armor] +10 damage and energy resistance per kill during a killstreak (max. 10).
